manifest.phase: Phase 13 — Joint Expert Co-Adaptation and Relational Compositional Diagnosis

conditions.label: 13A_baseline
conditions.description: Phase 12 Joint baseline reproduction (mixed F+R+C, frozen).

conditions.label: 13C_coadaptation
conditions.description: JointCo: same 3 branches + inter-branch fusion (H*3 -> H).

UNDERTRAINING.evidence_seed_0: Extended training (40 epochs) achieves 63.1% mixed mean, matching co-adaptation (64.2%). The Phase 12 gap was at least partly optimization-budget related.

BRANCH_INTERFERENCE.evidence_seed_0: Co-adaptation (64.2%) > extended training (63.1%) by < 2pp; marginal benefit.

RELATIONAL_CAPABILITY.evidence_seed_0: Removing the relational branch drops R/RC/FRC by an average of 1.4pp; modest contribution.

REPRESENTATION_FUSION.evidence_seed_0: R-signal probe = 80.0% (R information is present in the representation) but R-accuracy = 57.5% (the final head fails to use it).

RELATIONAL_SENSITIVITY.evidence_seed_0: Relational destruction drops R+RC by 1.7pp; weak sensitivity.

PORTFOLIO_LIMITATION.evidence_seed_0: Co-adapted Joint does not move the cross-family mixed ceiling (delta = +0.4pp); the existing portfolio is not the bottleneck.

OPTIMIZATION.evidence_seed_0: All Joint variants underperform by > 10pp vs. the parameter-matched control; optimization appears to be the dominant bottleneck.

BENCHMARK_LIMITATION.evidence_seed_0: Phase 13 best ceiling (67.1%) is essentially equal to Phase 12 (66.7%). The benchmark may be insufficient to discriminate Joint variants.

verdict_label: Fusion is the bottleneck (R info present but unused)
